rows: Platforms
Three Orin NX hosts with H8, H10, or DX.
Models
MobileNetV3-L, RegNet-X 1.6GF, ResNet-50, YOLO11l, YOLO26m, YOLO26s, YOLOv7.
Coverage
204 paired Native/Generic cuts and 42 host-specific Full alternatives.
Inputs
ImageNet validation at $224\times224$ and COCO 2017 validation at $640\times640$.
Precision
TensorRT Full builds enable FP16. Split bridges use float32 layout conversion or uint8 dequantization to FP16. Accelerator precision follows the compiled artifact.
Performance
Three independent process runs of 1,000 completed tasks. Available path records specify batch 1 and 100 drained warmups.
Energy
Input shunt with INA225 acquisition. Three 60-s repetitions at the calibrated DC system input, without idle subtraction.
Quality
Shared 5,000-image evaluation sets, bound by dataset hashes. 1,000 paired-bootstrap replicates.
